theme: Paying only for reductions that would not have happened
title: Additionality Desk: Buying Real Tonnes Under a Budget
strategies: naive baseline: skim only the first few listed projects (no quality signal used), first-fit under budget
price-per-claimed-tonne greedy: sort projects by $/tonne ascending, first-fit under budget (the cheap-offsets trap: buys mostly inflated-baseline, non-additional, low-permanence projects)

risk-adjusted knapsack: compute effective_tonnes per project from the additionality-counterfactual test, the reported-vs-reference baseline gap, and the permanence/reversal discount, then solve 0/1 knapsack on effective_tonnes under the dollar budget
invalid: spend past the budget / duplicate or out-of-range project indices
